title: The Great Rusted Canal
ground: Sluggish, ochre water thick with metallic sediment.
Corroded iron beams jut at angles from the canal walls.
A half-submerged barge, its hull a lacework of rust and barnacles.
Faint ripples from something large shifting below the surface.

will.ActiveWill: She wants to know if you carry anything that can be traded for safe passage or if you are a threat to her salvage.

shift: IF a character disturbs the water with a pole or oar → THEN a submerged grate releases a cloud of gas, causing coughing and reduced visibility for 1d4 rounds.
IF a character offers a working battery or tool to Nara → THEN she opens a hidden lock gate leading to a dry under-cavern filled with salvage.
IF a character attempts to cross without acknowledging her → THEN she whistles, and two rust-snakes surface near the boat, testing the hull.

drift.rate: Slow but steady – the canal’s chemical erosion accelerates metal decay by an hour per day of exposure.
drift.consequence: After 3 hours in this zone, any unsealed weapon or tool gains the Brittle tag (breaks on a natural 1 during use).

title: The Ministry of Seals
location: Tringad, Administrative Core – Hall of Infinite Forms
ground: Desks arranged in endless, interlocking rows, each burdened with stacks of yellowed paper.
A single gas lamp flickers overhead, casting long, dancing shadows.
The air smells of old ink, wax, and faint decay.
A mechanical seal-press stamps every few seconds, its rhythm hypnotic.

will.ActiveWill: He wants to verify your paperwork is absolutely perfect before he allows access to the sealed maps below.

shift: IF a character presents a document with a missing stamp → THEN Thaddeus slides a blank requisition form across the desk and demands a ‘Pragma Fee’ (1 resource token).
IF a character offers a bribe in the form of rare ink → THEN he stamps their papers immediately and mutters a code that unlocks a hidden file cabinet.
IF a character argues or raises their voice → THEN the gas lamp gutters, the seal-press stops, and two Automaton Scribes enter the room.

drift.rate: Coherence decays by one step per hour as bureaucracy folds in on itself.
drift.consequence: After two failed checks, characters are issued a ‘Null-Drag Notice’ – all future interactions here suffer a -1 penalty until resolved.

title: Shear Rupture – The Unspooling
location: Tringad, Sector 12 – Edge of the Riftlands
ground: Air shimmers like heat haze, but cold – reality visibly warps at the seams.
Jagged, glassy edges of exposed static space, where color has no name.
Broken cobblestones hover a few inches above the ground, slowly rotating.
Faint whispers from no one – words backwards, then forward, then in a loop.

will.ActiveWill: She is measuring the rupture’s expansion rate and wants coherent matter that could anchor the rift.

shift: IF a character throws an object into the rupture → THEN it is absorbed without sound, and a perfect duplicate appears 10 meters away.
IF a character touches the shimmering edge → THEN their limb becomes a Drift echo (perception lags 2 seconds behind reality).
IF a character uses a Logos tool near the rupture → THEN the tear shrinks by 2 meters and Lector Aris offers a data chip.

drift.rate: Fast – the static zone grows a meter per hour, pulling nearby matter into null-drag.
drift.consequence: If the rupture is not stabilized within 4 hours, a localized ‘Static Storm’ triggers, dealing 2d6 Coherence damage to all nearby organics.

title: The Sump Slums
ground: Ceiling of interwoven pipes weeping black oil and steam.
Shanties built from scrap metal and cured hides, roofs slick with condensation.
A central pit of boiling sump water, bubbling with methane.
Children’s faces in the shadows – watching, calculating.

will.ActiveWill: He wants to know if you are a threat to his operation or a potential customer for his ‘clean’ water filters.

shift: IF a character shows visible wealth → THEN Garret nods at two heavies who shadow you until you leave or pay a ‘floor tax’.
IF a character offers medical supplies → THEN he leads you to a hidden still and gives you a token for safe passage.
IF a character draws a weapon → THEN the children throw smoke bombs, and Garret vanishes into a trapdoor.

drift.rate: Moderate – the sump water level rises by 2 inches every hour, flooding the lowest hovels.
drift.consequence: After 2 hours of inaction, the central pit overflows, releasing toxic fumes (DC 12 Avoid/Endure or take 1d4 poison damage).
